listed_sector_signals.signal: Paper mills named as industrial customers within the water utility's service area (pulp & paper reference), but only as a customer, not as the study's application context
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The ZWA has about 125,000 customers, including 
industries such as paper mills and a dairy plant, spread 
over an area of 386 mi2.

one_line: The paper presents six case studies of energy management (efficiency, contracts, pumping, heating, micro-hydropower, aeration control) implemented at German municipal water/wastewater utilities, with paper mills mentioned only as utility customers.
